high_level_description: A single stylized cat in perched sitting pose, centered on a 1600x900 canvas with pale sky above and green grass below.

compositional_deconstruction.background: pale sky occupying upper 750px; grass band occupying lower 150px

elements.desc: cat body and head: orange-brown oval torso and circular head, centered horizontally, top at y=330, base at y=750
left front paw: rounded rectangle, extending forward from body left side
right front paw: rounded rectangle, symmetric to left front paw
left hind paw: small rounded rectangle, tucked under body near center-bottom
right hind paw: small rounded rectangle, symmetric to left hind paw
left ear: small triangle (approximated by narrow vertical rectangle)
right ear: small triangle (approximated by narrow vertical rectangle)
